introduction.en: A collection of Cowork anecdotes includes recurring expenses and annual tax preparation.
introduction.zh: 一组 Cowork 个案包含周期性费用整理与年度报税准备。

method.en: A roundup says one user forwards receipts for Cowork to accumulate and email a Monday expense report; another supplies a year of bank and credit-card exports for tax preparation.
method.zh: 汇编称一位用户转发收据，供Cowork累积并在周一邮件发送费用报告；另一位提供一年的银行与信用卡导出资料做报税准备。

method.en: A separate home-maintenance example reviewed ten years of email, extracted repair dates, contractors and costs, and synced a maintenance schedule to Google Calendar.
method.zh: 另一个家居维护示例查看十年邮件，提取维修日期、承包商与费用，再将维护计划同步至Google Calendar。

outcome.en: Tax-summary preparation was described as taking minutes rather than days, and a LinkedIn user estimated five hours saved. Financial accuracy was not measured.
outcome.zh: 税务汇总被描述为由数天缩至数分钟，另有LinkedIn用户估计省五小时；未测量财务准确性。

notes.en: The source cites a different file-renaming test with around70% correctness and a $20 Pro-plan weekly-cap concern. Neither is an accuracy benchmark for the finance tasks or a guarantee of current limits.
notes.zh: 源站引用另一文件重命名测试约70%正确率，并提醒20美元Pro计划的周用量上限；不能把它们当作财务任务准确率或当前配额保证。
